items.headline: US Cancels G20 Group Photo After Allies Object to Russian Presence
items.summary: The United States cancelled the traditional group photograph at the G20 foreign ministers meeting in Atlanta after multiple countries threatened a boycott. Diplomats from Australia, the United Kingdom, and European Union nations refused to pose alongside Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov because of Russia's war in Ukraine.

items.headline: Hackers Steal $6.3 Billion from Binance in Largest Crypto Breach in History
items.summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance disclosed that cyberattackers compromised internal systems and stole approximately $6.3 billion in digital assets. Security researchers linked the record-setting heist to North Korean state-sponsored hackers, making this major incident a primary global cybersecurity story today.

items.headline: Court Overturns Ban on Russian Teams in International Ice Hockey
items.summary: On October 30, 2026, the Court of Arbitration for Sport ruled that the International Ice Hockey Federation must readmit Russian national teams to five upcoming tournaments in the 2026–2027 season. The decision represents a major legal turning point in international sports governance following the broad suspensions imposed after the 2022 invasion of Ukraine.

items.headline: Global Tributes Pour In Following the Death of Acting Legend Sir Patrick Stewart at 86
items.summary: Acclaimed stage and screen actor Sir Patrick Stewart, beloved for his iconic roles as Captain Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek and Professor Charles Xavier in X-Men, has died at age 86 following a battle with Alzheimer's disease and Lewy body dementia. Tributes have flooded in from co-stars, filmmakers, and fans worldwide as the global entertainment community honors his extraordinary six-decade career.
